mapper.select: select source_id, table_name, record_id, field_name, source_url, quote, origin, verified_by, verified_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from abr_field_source where table_name = #{tableName} and record_id = #{recordId} order by field_name
mapper.insert: insert into abr_field_source (table_name, record_id, field_name, source_url, quote, origin, verified_by, verified_time, create_by, create_time) values (#{tableName}, #{recordId}, #{fieldName}, #{sourceUrl}, #{quote}, coalesce(#{origin}, '0'), #{verifiedBy}, now(), #{verifiedBy}, now()) on conflict (table_name, record_id, field_name) do update set source_url = excluded.source_url, quote = excluded.quote, origin = excluded.origin, verified_by = excluded.verified_by, verified_time = excluded.verified_time, update_by = excluded.verified_by, update_time = now()
